title: Kar rahi hai lehad se
body:
zulm jab bhi tha ab bhi hai mujh par yahan
baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kar rahi hai lehad se sakina fughan
baba jaan baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jald bhijwaiye ab alamdaar ko
badla lena hai karbal ke ghamkhwar ko
ro ke ye keh rahi hai meri dadi jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wohi nasl hai jisne baysheer ki
khodi nanhi lehad mere dilgeer ki
ab mazaaron ko todenge zaalim yahan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tod daali lehad tere ghamkaar ki
hujr ki bhi lehad aur ammar ki
kis khadar zulm hota hai hum par yahan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
todne rauze aaye hai aghiyaar ab
aap ki hai madad hum ko darkaar ab
aake hum ko bacha lo mere baba jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm jo dha rahe hai ye salfi hai sab
karbala ke munafiq yazeedi hai sab
zaalimo se bacha lo hame ammu jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon nikalta tha kaano se jab bhi mere
dard hota hai kaano mein ab bhi mere
mujh pe roti rahi khoon bhari baaliyan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne tab bhi maare tamache mujhe
taaziyane lagaye thay durre mujhe
baaliyan khenchi kaano se khoon tha rawan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hashmi ne ye ro ro ke nauha kaha
padke irfan bhi nauha rone laga
rone walon ko dengi dua dadi jaan
baba jaan baba jaan
kar rahi hai lehad se...
author: Alamdar Hashmi
